name: TSS, Inc.
business_overview: TSS, Inc. engages in the planning, design, deployment, maintenance, and refresh of end-user and enterprise systems in the United States. The company operates through three segments: Procurement, Facilities Management, and Systems Integration. The company offers IT equipment deployment services, including client products, enterprise products, clusters, and modular containers; and second-touch configuration services for OEM and end-user customers, such as adding software, hardware, or other features to end-user devices, bundling such devices with peripherals, pre-loading customer-determined application software, tagging, asset capture, and other fulfillment services. It also provides consulting, deployment, and maintenance and management services. In addition, the company is involved in procuring third-party hardware and software, as well as provides professional services. The company serves IT OEM equipment, technology, and service companies; private sector businesses; and government or commercial end users. The company was formerly known as Fortress International Group, Inc. and changed its name to TSS, Inc. in June 2013. TSS, Inc. was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Georgetown, Texas.

classification_meta.logic_summary: IT services company providing procurement, deployment, and systems integration to enterprise and government clients.

narrative.text:
**Business & market dynamics:** The company’s higher-value Systems Integration segment, centered on AI rack assembly and deployment, is experiencing strong demand momentum, driven by hyperscale and OEM AI infrastructure buildouts. This growth is partially obscured by the lumpy, lower-margin Procurement business, which creates uneven top-line comparisons. The Georgetown facility has become the core growth asset, positioning TSSI as a specialized integration partner for large equipment OEMs, with activity concentrated in the expanding high-performance computing and AI data center market.

**Management strategy and execution:** Leadership is successfully shifting the business mix toward higher-margin integration services while strategically expanding rack integration capacity to meet accelerating AI demand. Management refined its full-year outlook upward, signaling confidence in operational execution and near-term visibility. The team’s ability to capitalize on its OEM relationships and deliver strong integration growth against a backdrop of volatile procurement volumes is bolstering credibility, with the market rewarding the clearer focus on the AI infrastructure integration niche.
